items.t: Relatlimab 加纳武单抗与纳武单抗治疗晚期黑色素瘤：3 期 RELATIVITY-047 试验的 5 年生存率和生物标志物分析
items.te: Relatlimab plus nivolumab versus nivolumab for advanced melanoma: 5-year survival and biomarker analyses of the phase 3 RELATIVITY-047 trial
items.s: 根据 RELATIVITY-047 试验，纳武单抗联合 relatlimab 被批准用于治疗晚期黑色素瘤；然而，需要长期数据。在这项预先指定的 5 年分析中，最短随访时间为 57.3 个月，纳武单抗联合 relatlimab 证明，与纳武单抗相比，在 PFS（风险比 = 0.77；95% 置信区间：0.65–0.92）、OS（风险比 = 0.78；95% 置信区间：0.64–0.95）和 MSS（风险比 = 0.71；95% 置信区间：0.57–0.88）。
items.se: Nivolumab plus relatlimab is approved for advanced melanoma based on the RELATIVITY-047 trial; however, long-term data are needed. In this prespecified 5-year analysis, with a minimum follow-up of 57.3 months, nivolumab plus relatlimab demonstrated continued clinically significant benefit versus nivolumab for PFS (hazard ratio = 0.77; 95% confidence interval: 0.65–0.92), OS (hazard ratio = 0.78; 95% confidence interval: 0.64–0.95), and MSS (hazard ratio = 0.71; 95% confidence interval: 0.57–0.88).

items.t: 对错误临床人工智能的人工监督和决策支持系统审查和荟萃分析
items.te: Human oversight of erroneous clinical AI and decision support a systematic review and meta analysis
items.s: 人工智能 (AI) 越来越多地支持临床决策，但只有当临床医生认识到并抵制错误输出时，人类监督才具有保护作用。我们系统地回顾了临床医生对不正确的自动建议的反应的对照研究和现实世界研究。 46 份报告代表 41 个独立群组，其中包括 40 个核心群组。在三个调整后的队列中，临床医生正确的自动建议的正确性明显高于错误的自动建议（汇总 OR 10.19，95% CI 7.43–13.98；I² = 0%）； a ≥ 2020 的敏感性分析相似但不精确（OR 9.22，95% CI 2.06–41.13）。在四项异构真实世界计算机心电图研究中，26.6% 的错误解释未被纠正或识别（95% CI 6.4–65.6%；I² = 95.8%）。
items.se: Artificial intelligence (AI) increasingly supports clinical decisions, but human oversight is protective only if clinicians recognize and resist erroneous output. We systematically reviewed controlled and real-world studies of clinician responses to incorrect automated advice. Forty-six reports represented 41 independent cohort clusters, including 40 core cohorts. Across three adjusted cohorts, clinician correctness was substantially higher with correct than incorrect automated advice (pooled OR 10.19, 95% CI 7.43–13.98; I² = 0%); a ≥ 2020 sensitivity analysis was similar but imprecise (OR 9.22, 95% CI 2.06–41.13). In four heterogeneous real-world computerized ECG studies, 26.6% of erroneous interpretations were not corrected or recognized (95% CI 6.4–65.6%; I² = 95.8%).

editorial.reason: 系统综述与meta分析首次量化'人类监督'在AI出错时并非可靠防线：正确 vs 错误自动建议下临床医生正确率差异巨大（OR 10.19），真实世界心电AI错误中约26.6%未被纠正，对AI临床部署与人机协同研究设计均有直接参考。局限在于仅三个调整后队列纳入主分析、真实世界研究异质性极高（I²=95.8%），且不良事件证据仅来自单个回顾性队列。

reviews.reason: 系统综述量化了医生对错误AI建议的依从风险（错误输出下正确率大幅下降，ECG错误中约26.6%未被纠正），对临床AI部署的人机监督设计有直接参考价值；但汇集队列极少、异质性极高，结论精度有限。

items.t: 胰腺癌中淋巴结靶向、mKRAS 特异性两亲疫苗：随机 2 期 AMPLIFY-7P 试验
items.te: Lymph node-targeted, mKRAS-specific amphiphile vaccine in pancreatic cancer: the randomized phase 2 AMPLIFY-7P trial
items.s: 在 1 期 AMPLIFY-201 试验中，Camupepimut (ELI-002 7P) 驱动突变 KRAS (mKRAS) 特异性 T 细胞反应，该反应与 mKRAS 胰腺腺癌 (PDAC) 患者的无病生存 (DFS) 和总生存 (OS) 相关。 DFS 事后多变量 Cox 回归分析表明 camupepimut 的结果有所改善（调整后的 HR 0.47，P = 0.0086），III 期疾病的结果较差（调整后的 HR 2.29，P = 0.0127），基线 CA19-9 升高（调整后的 HR 3.16，P < 0.0001）和基线循环肿瘤 DNA (ctDNA) 阳性（调整后的 HR） 5.99，P < 0.0001）。在接受 camupepimut 治疗的患者中，mKRAS 特异性 T 细胞应答较基线高 9.17 倍（82.2%，74/90）与 DFS 改善相关（HR 0.22，P < 0.0001），中位 DFS 未达到，而高于和低于 9.17 倍的中位 DFS 分别为 6.08 个月。
items.se: Camupepimut (ELI-002 7P) drives mutated KRAS (mKRAS)-specific T cell responses that correlated with disease-free survival (DFS) and overall survival (OS) in patients with mKRAS pancreatic adenocarcinoma (PDAC) in the phase 1 AMPLIFY-201 trial. Post hoc multivariate Cox regression analysis of DFS indicated an improved outcome for camupepimut (adjusted HR 0.47, P = 0.0086), a worse outcome for stage III disease (adjusted HR 2.29, P = 0.0127), an elevated baseline CA19-9 (adjusted HR 3.16, P < 0.0001) and baseline circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) positivity (adjusted HR 5.99, P < 0.0001). In camupepimut-treated patients, mKRAS-specific T cell response >9.17-fold over baseline (82.2%, 74/90) correlated with improved DFS (HR 0.22, P < 0.0001), with the median DFS not reached versus 6.08 months for above and below 9.17-fold, respectively.

items.t: 淋巴瘤患者多中心、多试验队列分析中 CAR T 细胞治疗反应的决定因素
items.te: Determinants of response to CAR T cell therapy in a multicenter, multi-trial cohort analysis of patients with lymphoma
items.s: 在接受嵌合抗原受体 (CAR) T 细胞疗法治疗的非霍奇金淋巴瘤 (NHL) 患者中，与疗效相关的因素与预后生物标志物重叠。高比例的幼稚样 (CCR7+CD45RA+) T 细胞是与延长无进展生存期相关的最显着特征（PFS；风险比 = 0.46，95% 置信区间：0.31−0.68，P = 9.8 × 10−5，高幼稚样 T 细胞组与低幼稚样 T 细胞组），且不影响安全性。在多变量模型中，幼稚表型优于炎症标志物和肿瘤负荷等临床病理特征，在调整产品扩展后仍然显着。主要发现在一个由 203 名接受基于 axi-cel 的疗法或 brexucabtagene autoleucel 治疗的患者组成的独立队列中得到验证。
items.se: In patients with non-Hodgkin lymphoma (NHL) treated with chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cell therapy, factors associated with efficacy overlap with prognostic biomarkers. A high proportion of naive-like (CCR7+CD45RA+) T cells was the most significant feature associated with prolonged progression-free survival (PFS; hazard ratio = 0.46, 95% confidence interval: 0.31−0.68, P = 9.8 × 10−5, high versus low naive-like T cell groups) without impacting safety. In multivariate models, the naive-like phenotype outperformed clinicopathologic features such as inflammatory markers and tumor burden, remaining significant after adjusting for product expansion. The key findings were validated in an independent cohort of 203 patients treated with axi-cel-based therapy or brexucabtagene autoleucel.

items.t: 活体肾脏捐赠后的妊娠结果。
items.te: Pregnancy Outcomes After Living Kidney Donation.
items.s: 尽管证据尚不清楚，但活体肾脏捐赠后怀孕的人发生妊娠相关不良后果的风险可能会增加。确定活体肾脏捐赠后的妊娠是否与非捐赠者中的匹配妊娠相比不良妊娠结局的风险更高。这项匹配队列研究使用了加拿大安大略省、不列颠哥伦比亚省和阿尔伯塔省的省级行政医疗保健数据库，纳入了年龄在 18 岁至 42 岁之间的活体女性肾脏捐献者，她们在 1992 年 7 月至 2021 年 8 月期间捐献了肾脏，随后进行了至少 20 周妊娠的单胎妊娠。这些妊娠与女性非捐赠者中妊娠至少 20 周的单胎妊娠按 1:4 进行匹配。
items.se: People who become pregnant after living kidney donation may be at increased risk of pregnancy-related adverse outcomes, although the evidence is unclear. To determine whether pregnancies after living kidney donation are associated with a higher risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes than matched pregnancies among nondonors. This matched cohort study used provincial administrative health care databases from Ontario, British Columbia, and Alberta, Canada, and included living female kidney donors aged 18 to 42 years who donated a kidney between July 1992 and August 2021 and subsequently had singleton pregnancies of at least 20 weeks' gestation. These pregnancies were matched 1:4 with singleton pregnancies of at least 20 weeks' gestation among female nondonors.

editorial.reason: 大样本匹配队列（385例捐肾者妊娠对1540例对照）量化了活体供肾后妊娠的高血压疾病及小于胎龄儿风险（RR 1.51和1.86），对供者知情同意与产前管理有直接指导价值；属观察性数据，且多数妊娠结局良好，不宜外推为因果。

items.t: 商业人工智能在肺栓塞和偶发性肺栓塞检测中的多站点真实性能
items.te: Multi-site real-world performance of commercial AI for pulmonary and incidental pulmonary embolism detection
items.s: 肺栓塞 (PE) 是心血管死亡的主要原因，但经 FDA 批准的人工智能检测模型的实际性能仍未完全表征。使用经过验证的 LLM 流程从放射学报告中提取参考标准标签（准确度为 97%，κ = 0.94）。 PE 模型的敏感性为 86.8%，特异性为 99.1%，敏感性从鞍部栓塞的 99.3% 下降到亚段性 PE 的 72.9%，急性 PE 的敏感性从 89.7% 下降到非急性 PE 的 65.3%。 iPE 模型的灵敏度为 73.5%，特异性为 99.8%。这两种模型的灵敏度均低于 FDA 批准的基准，但超过了批准的特异性，外周和非急性栓塞的性能不断下降，反映了已知的人类读者的局限性，并强调了对人工智能医疗设备进行标准化上市后监测的必要性。
items.se: Pulmonary embolism (PE) is a leading cause of cardiovascular mortality, yet the real-world performance of FDA-cleared AI detection models remains incompletely characterized. Reference-standard labels were extracted from radiology reports using a validated LLM pipeline (97% accuracy, κ = 0.94). The PE model achieved 86.8% sensitivity and 99.1% specificity, with sensitivity declining from 99.3% for saddle emboli to 72.9% for subsegmental PE, and from 89.7% for acute to 65.3% for non-acute PE. The iPE model achieved 73.5% sensitivity and 99.8% specificity. Both models demonstrated lower sensitivity than FDA-clearance benchmarks while exceeding cleared specificity, with diminishing performance for peripheral and non-acute emboli mirroring known human reader limitations and underscoring the need for standardized post-market surveillance of AI-enabled medical devices.

items.t: 无声评估揭示了人工智能生成的临床消息的自动化指标的上下文相关有效性
items.te: Silent evaluation reveals context-dependent validity of automated metrics for AI-generated clinical messages
items.s: 对人工智能生成的患者沟通的评估缺乏标准化框架，自动化指标可能无法反映临床效用。我们利用 GPT 生成的针对患者门户消息的草稿响应 (GDR) 分阶段推出。 2023 年 9 月至 2024 年 8 月，30 名初级保健医生在两种情况下收到了草稿：干预组显示和编辑人工智能草稿 (n = 21,073)，以及非显示组，生成草稿但从未向医生展示，医生独立撰写回复 (n = 45,127)。我们使用 BLEU、ROUGE、BERTScore 和 Flesch Reading Ease 评估信息，然后将自动化指标与盲法医生对有效性、误解潜力和危害的评级相关联。在干预组中，2264 (11%) 草稿被纳入具有高度语义对齐的最终消息中 (BERTScore F1 = 0.93)。
items.se: Evaluation of AI-generated patient communication lacks standardized frameworks, and automated metrics may not reflect clinical utility. We leveraged a staged rollout of GPT-generated draft responses (GDRs) to patient portal messages. Thirty primary care physicians received drafts from September 2023 to August 2024 under two conditions: an intervention group where AI drafts were displayed and edited (n = 21,073), and a non-displayed group where drafts were generated but never shown to physicians, who composed responses independently (n = 45,127). We evaluated messages using BLEU, ROUGE, BERTScore, and Flesch Reading Ease, and then correlated automated metrics with blinded physician ratings of effectiveness, misunderstanding potential, and harm. In the intervention group, 2264 (11%) drafts were incorporated into final messages with high semantic alignment (BERTScore F1 = 0.93).

editorial.reason: 利用静默对照设计提供了少见的高通量真实场景数据（66k+消息），实证显示BLEU/ROUGE/BERTScore等自动指标仅在AI草稿被展示编辑时有效，无法反映AI独立生成质量或医生偏好，对临床生成式AI评测方法设计有直接警示价值。主要限制是单一机构、初级保健场景，相关性结论依赖该 rollout 语境。

items.t: 1990-2023 年全球、区域和国家百日咳负担：全球疾病负担研究
items.te: Global, regional and national burden of pertussis in 1990–2023: a Global Burden of Disease study
items.s: 尽管有长期的免疫计划，百日咳仍然是疫苗可预防的死亡的主要原因，特别是在婴儿中。在这里，我们对 1990 年至 2023 年 204 个国家和地区的全球百日咳发病率、死亡率和伤残调整生命年进行了初步评估。我们表明，尽管大流行期间存在短期波动，但 1990 年至 2023 年的全球主导模式是长期下降：年龄标准化死亡率下降了 61.2%，年龄标准化发病率下降了 41.6%。相对于大流行期间异常低的估计值，2020 年至 2023 年间，发病率和死亡率分别反弹了 102.6%（95% 不确定性区间，77.0-128.2%）和 66.1%（95% 不确定性区间，2.4-174.5%）。仅在 2023 年，我们估计就有 1,890 万例病例和 115,000 例死亡归因于百日咳。
items.se: Despite long-standing immunization programs, pertussis remains a major cause of vaccine-preventable mortality, particularly among infants. Here we present a primary assessment of global pertussis incidence, mortality and disability-adjusted life years across 204 countries and territories from 1990 to 2023. We show that despite short-term pandemic-period fluctuations, the dominant global pattern from 1990 to 2023 was long-term decline: age-standardized mortality decreased by 61.2% and age-standardized incidence by 41.6%. Relative to the anomalously low pandemic-period estimates, incidence and mortality rebounded by 102.6% (95% uncertainty interval, 77.0–128.2%) and 66.1% (95% uncertainty interval, 2.4–174.5%), respectively, between 2020 and 2023. In 2023 alone, we estimated 18.9 million cases and 115,000 deaths attributable to pertussis.

items.t: 荷兰月经过多女性的子宫内膜去除术加左炔诺孕酮宫内缓释系统与单独子宫内膜去除术的比较（MIRA2）：一项多中心、开放标签、随机、对照、优效性试验。
items.te: Endometrial ablation plus levonorgestrel-releasing intrauterine system versus endometrial ablation alone in women with heavy menstrual bleeding in The Netherlands (MIRA2): a multicentre, open-label, randomised, controlled, superiority trial.
items.s: 子宫内膜去除术对于月经出血过多的女性来说是一种既定且有效的治疗方法，但许多患者需要进一步治疗，大约 10% 的患者最终在 2 年内接受了子宫切除术。子宫内膜消融后立即插入左炔诺孕酮宫内缓释系统（LNG-IUS）可能会使残留的未经治疗的子宫内膜失活或阻止其再生，从而防止需要子宫切除术的复发症状。该研究的目的是评估对于月经过多的女性，子宫内膜去除术后立即插入 LNG-IUS 与单独子宫内膜去除相比，是否可以减少 2 年内随后进行子宫切除术的需要。这项多中心、开放标签、随机、对照、优效性试验在荷兰 34 家医院进行。
items.se: Endometrial ablation is an established and effective treatment for women with heavy menstrual bleeding, but many patients require further treatment, with approximately 10% ultimately undergoing a hysterectomy within 2 years. The insertion of a levonorgestrel-releasing intrauterine system (LNG-IUS) immediately after endometrial ablation might inactivate residual untreated endometrium or prevent its regeneration, thereby preventing recurrent symptoms necessitating a hysterectomy. The aim of the study was to assess whether LNG-IUS insertion immediately after endometrial ablation in women with heavy menstrual bleeding reduced the need for subsequent hysterectomy within 2 years compared with endometrial ablation alone. This multicentre, open-label, randomised, controlled, superiority trial was conducted in 34 hospitals in the Netherlands.

items.t: GUARD-LGG：神经胶质瘤前期人工智能驱动的低级别神经胶质瘤放疗反应解密
items.te: GUARD-LGG: a glioma upfront AI-driven radiotherapy response decipher for lower-grade glioma
items.s: 在这里，我们提出了 GUARD-LGG，这是一种机器学习模型，旨在预测治疗前 LGG 的早期 RT 反应。 GUARD-LGG 在试验中的 AUC 分别为 0.946 (95% CI: 0.938–0.962)、0.929 (95% CI: 0.894–0.965)、0.882 (95% CI: 0.830–0.934) 和 0.913 (95% CI: 0.878–0.949)。分别是训练集、内部验证集、外部测试集和预期测试集。
items.se: Here we present GUARD-LGG, a machine learning model designed to predict early RT response in LGG before treatment. GUARD-LGG achieved AUCs of 0.946 (95% CI: 0.938–0.962), 0.929 (95% CI: 0.894–0.965), 0.882 (95% CI: 0.830–0.934), and 0.913 (95% CI: 0.878–0.949) in the training, internal validation, external, and prospective test sets, respectively.

items.t: Medicare Advantage 家庭健康风险评估中心血管疾病的诊断和治疗。
items.te: Diagnosis and Treatment of Cardiovascular Conditions in Medicare Advantage In-Home Health Risk Assessments.
items.s: 背景 Medicare Advantage 保险公司进行家庭健康风险评估 (HRA)，以识别高风险患者并促进适当的护理。批评者认为，这种做法增加了风险调整后的付款，却没有提高质量。缺乏有关家用 HRA 的使用和下游处理的综合数据。目的 研究家庭 HRA 期间诊断出的心血管疾病的趋势、与基于 HRA 的诊断相关的特征以及诊断后的治疗率。设计队列研究。设置基于人口。参与者 Medicare Advantage 受益人。测量 使用 100% 医疗保险索赔，检查了在家 HRA（与基于机构的就诊）期间诊断出的心血管疾病比例的趋势。
items.se: Background Medicare Advantage insurers conduct in-home health risk assessments (HRAs) to identify high-risk patients and facilitate appropriate care. Critics argue this practice increases risk-adjusted payments without improving quality. Comprehensive data on use of in-home HRAs and downstream treatment are lacking. items.s: 我们开发了 OUD-REY（1 年 OUD 风险评估器）——一种深度学习模型，使用来自 All of Us 研究计划的纵向电子健康记录 (EHR) 数据来预测阿片类药物处方患者一年后的 OUD 风险。在内部验证中，OUD-REY 的 AUROC 为 91.2%，AUPRC 为 77.0%。我们在 All of Us 发布的新数据集（暂时与我们的开发集分离）以及包含 20 年来全国退伍军人事务部 (VA) 医疗中心约 600 万患者的数据集上对我们的模型进行了外部验证。在外部验证中，我们的模型在时间上分离的 All of Us 验证集上的 AUROC 和 AUPRC 分别为 86.4% 和 23.1%（OUD 流行率为 2.9%）。
items.se: We developed OUD-REY (OUD Risk Evaluator at 1 Year) - a deep learning model that uses longitudinal electronic health record (EHR) data from the All of Us research program to predict risk of OUD at one year for patients with an opioid prescription. On internal validation, OUD-REY achieved an AUROC of 91.2% and AUPRC of 77.0%. We externally validated our model on a new dataset released by All of Us that was temporally separated from our development set and on a dataset containing ~6 million patients from medical centers of the Veterans Affairs (VA) nationwide over a span of 20 years. On external validation, our model had an AUROC and AUPRC of 86.4% and 23.1% (OUD prevalence of 2.9%), respectively, on our temporally separated All of Us validation set.

items.te: Molecular predictors of minimal residual disease in newly diagnosed multiple myeloma treated with quadruplet therapy
items.s: 四联疗法结合了抗CD38抗体、免疫调节药物、蛋白酶体抑制剂和地塞米松，现已成为新诊断的多发性骨髓瘤（NDMM）的标准诱导治疗。这些与 MRD 相关的转录组学特征在 CASSIOPEIA 队列中得到了独立验证。全基因组测序揭示了 MMRF 队列中验证的已知（APOBEC 突变、染色体碎裂）和新的基因组不稳定表型。整合基因组、转录组和表观基因组特征的多模态随机森林模型预测诱导后的 MRD 状态，曲线下面积为 0.77，优于临床和基因组模型，同时提供相对于转录组和表观基因组模型的可比较的区分度和改进的校准。
items.se: Quadruplet therapy, combining anti-CD38 antibodies, immunomodulatory drugs, proteasome inhibitors and dexamethasone, is now the standard induction treatment for newly diagnosed multiple myeloma (NDMM). These MRD-associated transcriptomic features were independently validated in the CASSIOPEIA cohort. Whole-genome sequencing revealed both known (APOBEC mutagenesis, chromothripsis) and new genomic instability phenotypes validated in the MMRF cohort. A multimodal random forest model integrating genomic, transcriptomic and epigenomic features predicted MRD status after induction, with an area under the curve of 0.77, outperforming clinical and genomic models, while providing comparable discrimination and improved calibration relative to the transcriptomic and epigenomic models.

items.s: 重要性 目前尚不清楚术中血流动力学治疗是否应以心脏指数为指导。目的 评估个体化心脏指数引导的血流动力学治疗与常规血流动力学治疗相比是否可以改善接受择期腹部大手术的高危患者的预后。设计、设置和参与者这项多中心、单盲、优效性随机临床试验招募了2023年10月8日至2025年10月25日期间在奥地利、捷克共和国、丹麦、德国和西班牙的12个大学医疗中心接受选择性腹部大手术的高危患者。最后一次随访的日期是 2026 年 1 月 15 日。 干预措施 患者被随机分配接受以患者术前静息心脏指数为目标的个体化心脏指数指导血流动力学治疗与常规血流动力学治疗（采用盲法心脏指数监测）。
items.se: Importance It remains unclear if intraoperative hemodynamic therapy should be guided by cardiac index. Objective To evaluate whether individualized cardiac index-guided hemodynamic therapy vs routine hemodynamic therapy improves outcomes in high-risk patients undergoing elective major abdominal surgery. Design, setting, and participants This multicenter, single-blind, superiority randomized clinical trial enrolled high-risk patients undergoing elective major abdominal surgery between October 8, 2023, and October 25, 2025, at 12 university medical centers in Austria, the Czech Republic, Denmark, Germany, and Spain. The date of last follow-up was January 15, 2026. Interventions Patients were randomized to individualized cardiac index-guided hemodynamic therapy targeting the patient's preoperative resting cardiac index vs routine hemodynamic therapy (with blinded cardiac index monitoring).

items.t: 常见的 CD36 变异和非洲血统个体扩张型心肌病的遗传景观。
items.te: A Common CD36 Variant and the Genetic Landscape of Dilated Cardiomyopathy in Individuals of African Ancestry.
items.s: 重要性扩张型心肌病 (DCM) 是心力衰竭的一个主要原因，对非洲血统的个体影响尤为严重，其中与欧洲血统的个体相比，疾病的家族聚集性更为明显。 TTN（编码肌节蛋白肌联蛋白）的截短变异是 DCM 最常见的单基因原因。一种在非洲血统个体中丰富的常见 CD36 无义变异也已被证明是 DCM 的重大负担。目的 比较 CD36 无义变异与 TTN 截短变异以及其他已确定的 DCM 基因中的致病或可能致病变异对 DCM 风险的贡献。
items.se: Importance Dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM) is a major cause of heart failure that disproportionately affects individuals of predominantly African ancestry, among whom familial clustering of disease is more pronounced relative to those of predominantly European ancestry. Truncating variants in TTN, which encodes the sarcomeric protein titin, are the most common established monogenic cause of DCM. A common CD36 nonsense variant enriched among individuals of African ancestry has also been shown to account for a substantial burden of DCM. items.s: 美国食品和药物管理局周四在一份早期警报中表示，在收到三份气球在充气过程中破裂的报告后，Edwards Lifesciences 已要求客户从库存中移除一些用于 Sapien M3 经导管二尖瓣置换术的输送系统。截至 10 月 5 日，Edwards 报告了与该问题相关的 1 人死亡和 1 人重伤，当时该设备制造商致函客户，建议他们将 Commander M 系统从使用或销售的地方移除并将其退回公司。 FDA 表示，这个问题可能会导致栓塞或阻止医生通过引导鞘取回装置，从而需要额外的干预措施，例如手术。潜在的高风险干预措施可能会带来严重的不良健康后果。
items.se: Edwards Lifesciences has asked customers to remove from inventory some delivery systems used for Sapien M3 transcatheter mitral valve replacement after receiving three reports of balloons bursting during inflation, the Food and Drug Administration said Thursday in an early alert. The potentially high-risk intervention carries a risk of serious adverse health consequences.

items.t: 评估大型语言模型衍生的输出作为心理测量：适用于日常压力的五领域心理测量框架
items.te: Evaluating Large Language Model–Derived Outputs as Psychological Measures: A Five-Domain Psychometric Framework With Application to Daily Stress
items.s: 结论：仅预测指标不足以评估大语言模型衍生的心理测量。以测量为导向的评估揭示了一些属性，包括水平相关效应和不对称误差归因，这些属性对基于大语言模型的评估研究如何解释其结果有直接影响。对于临床使用，该措施是对现有纵向监测筛查仪器的补充，而不是独立的诊断。结果：特征显示出高重复性（平均组内相关系数 = 0.987）、结构依赖性收敛效度（Spearman ρ = 0.08 至 0.79）以及当天压力的个人跟踪（负面情绪 β = 0.68）。
items.se: Conclusions: Prediction metrics alone are insufficient for evaluating LLM-derived psychological measures. Measurement-oriented evaluation revealed properties, including level-dependent effects and asymmetric error attribution, that have direct implications for how LLM-based assessment studies interpret their results. For clinical use, the measure is a complement to existing screening instruments for longitudinal monitoring, not a stand-alone diagnostic. Results: Features showed high repeatability (mean intraclass correlation coefficient=0.987), construct-dependent convergent validity (Spearman ρ=0.08 to 0.79), and within-person tracking of same-day stress (negative emotion β=0.68).

items.t: 医学诊断成像中合成图像的质量评估和模型训练影响：系统评价
items.te: Quality Assessment and Model Training Impact of Synthetic Images in Medical Diagnostic Imaging: Systematic Review
items.s: 结论：与之前仅限于特定疾病、成像方式或生成架构的综述不同，这篇综述提供了合成图像质量评估和下游模型性能的跨领域定量综合。目前，合成图像作为真实训练数据的补充比作为替代品更有价值，分类性能略有改善，分割收益较小，并且仅合成训练的性能通常较差。对于研究人员、开发人员和监管机构来说，这些发现强调了在合成图像管道转化为临床人工智能应用之前需要标准化的多方法图像质量评估、完整的报告和严格的外部验证。试用注册：PROSPERO CRD42023369125；结果：总共纳入 160 项研究。
items.se: Conclusions: Unlike previous reviews restricted to particular diseases, imaging modalities, or generative architectures, this review provides a cross-domain quantitative synthesis of both synthetic-image quality assessment and downstream model performance. Synthetic images currently appear more valuable as a complement to real training data than as a replacement, with modest improvements in classification performance, smaller gains in segmentation, and generally poorer performance with synthetic-only training. For researchers, developers, and regulators, these findings highlight the need for standardized multimethod image-quality evaluation, complete reporting, and rigorous external validation before synthetic-image pipelines are translated into clinical AI applications. items.se: Importance International guidelines recommend dobutamine for management of septic shock and cardiac dysfunction with persistent hypoperfusion in adults based on very low-certainty evidence. Objective To determine whether intraoperative dobutamine combined with norepinephrine reduces acute kidney injury (AKI) within 7 postoperative days in patients with septic shock undergoing surgical source control. Design, setting, and participants This randomized, open-label clinical trial in 39 tertiary hospitals in China enrolled adults with septic shock who were undergoing surgical source control between June 2024 and August 2025. Follow-up ended on November 15, 2025.

items.se: Objective To characterise the reporting completeness of clinical trials involving large language model (LLM) interventions using established reporting guidelines. items.te: Benzodiazepine Use Early in Pregnancy and Risk for Congenital Malformations.
items.s: 背景 关于妊娠期使用苯二氮卓类药物引起的畸形的现有数据是相互矛盾的。目的 评估妊娠早期接触苯二氮卓类药物导致主要先天畸形的风险。设计基于人群的美国队列研究。设置 Medicaid (2000-2018) 和 Merative MarketScan (2003-2020) 数据库。参与者 怀孕前 90 天至产后 30 天的孕妇以及出生后 90 天的活产婴儿。测量 暴露定义为在妊娠早期至少服用 1 次苯二氮卓类药物。主要结局是先前与苯二氮卓类药物暴露相关的任何主要先天性畸形和器官特异性畸形。
items.se: Background Existing data on malformations associated with benzodiazepine use in pregnancy are conflicting. Objective To assess the risk for major congenital malformations from first-trimester exposure to benzodiazepines. Design Population-based U.S. cohort study. Setting Medicaid (2000-2018) and Merative MarketScan (2003-2020) databases. Participants Pregnant persons enrolled from 90 days before pregnancy to 30 days after delivery, and their live-born infants enrolled for 90 days after birth. Measurements Exposure was defined as at least 1 fill of a benzodiazepine in the first trimester. Primary outcomes were any major congenital malformation and organ-specific malformations previously associated with benzodiazepine exposure.

items.t: Stryker 向 CMR Surgical 投资 4 亿美元，进军软组织机器人领域
items.te: Stryker enters soft tissue robotics with $400M investment in CMR Surgical
items.s: Stryker 周一表示，已与软组织机器人公司 CMR Surgical 合作，向该公司投资约 4 亿美元，并成为 CMR 系统的美国独家经销商。总部位于英国剑桥的 CMR 去年获得了美国食品和药物管理局的批准，其最新的机器人系统可以在美国执行胆囊手术。摩根大通分析师罗比·马库斯在一份研究报告中写道，截至 2026 年初，该公司已在全球执行了超过 45,000 例手术。 Stifel 分析师 Rick Wise 在一份研究报告中写道，多年来，史赛克一直被期望进入软组织机器人市场。怀斯补充道，随着竞争对手强生公司和美敦力公司在美国的机器人获得 FDA 批准，“对于史赛克来说，现在是时候做出决定了，机不可失。”
items.se: Stryker said Monday it has partnered with soft tissue robotics firm CMR Surgical, investing about $400 million into the company and becoming the exclusive U.S. distributor of CMR’s system. Cambridge, England-based CMR received Food and Drug Administration clearance for its latest robotic system last year to perform gallbladder procedures in the U.S. As of early 2026, the company had performed more than 45,000 procedures globally, J.P. Morgan analyst Robbie Marcus wrote in a research note. Stryker had been expected to enter the soft tissue robotics market for years, Stifel analyst Rick Wise wrote in a research note. With competitors Johnson & Johnson and Medtronic receiving FDA nods for their own robots in the U.S., Wise added, “it feels like a now or never moment for Stryker to make the decision.”

items.t: 美国捐赠者心脏分配的成人医疗紧急度评分的制定和验证。
items.te: Development and Validation of an Adult Medical Urgency Score for US Donor Heart Allocation.
items.s: 重要性 在美国，五分之一的心脏移植候选人会死亡或未经移植而被除名。目前，捐献者的心脏是由基于 6 种状态的治疗系统进行分配的，该系统因风险分层有限且容易受到博弈的影响而受到批评。目的 根据客观医疗紧急度评分制定新的心脏分配政策，根据生理学和机械循环支持之间的相互作用对候选者进行排名。使用美国器官移植系统的数据设计、设置和参与者基于登记的观察性研究。 2019年1月至2025年8月的所有成人（年龄≥18岁）心脏移植候选者均被纳入，分为训练（2019-2023）、验证（2023-2024）和测试（2024-2025）数据集。主要结果和措施 估算了不进行移植的 6 周死亡率的边际结构模型（美国候选者风险评分 [US-CRS]）。
items.se: Importance One in 5 heart transplant candidates in the US die or are delisted without transplant. Donor hearts are currently allocated by a 6-status therapy-based system criticized for limited risk stratification and susceptibility to gaming. Objective To develop a new heart allocation policy based on an objective medical urgency score that ranks candidates based on the interaction between physiology and mechanical circulatory support. Design, setting, and participants Registry-based observational study using data from the US organ transplant system. All adult (aged ≥18 years) heart transplant candidates from January 2019 to August 2025 were included, split into training (2019-2023), validation (2023-2024), and test (2024-2025) datasets. Main outcomes and measures A marginal structural model of 6-week mortality without transplant was estimated (the US Candidate Risk Score [US-CRS]).
